author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಗ್ಗನರಕಗಳೆಂದು ದೊರೆಯುವುದು ಭೂಮಿಯಲೆ
ತಗ್ಗಿ ನಡೆ ಸಗ್ಗವಿದೆ ದುಷ್ಕೃತಿಯೆ ನರಕ
ನುಗ್ಗುತಲೆ ಸತ್ಯದೆಡೆ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿನಡೆ ದುಷ್ಟತೆಯ
ಹಿಗ್ಗಿ ಸಗ್ಗವ ಪಡೆವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Heaven and hell are both found here on earth;
walk humbly and there is heaven; wrongdoing is hell;
press on towards truth, tread wickedness underfoot,
and you will joyfully reach heaven, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Heaven and hell are not far-off places but the fruit of how we live now. Humility and truth make heaven; wrongdoing makes hell.
